name: Orthographic
desc: A general-arrangement plate of a bossed bracket in true orthographic projection — plan, front and side elevations laid out in first or third angle with heavy visible outlines, dashed hidden bores, dash-dot centrelines and arrowheaded dimensions whose numbers keep changing because the part itself is slowly morphing, while an isometric pictorial turns in the fourth quadrant.

energy.doc: outline weight + pictorial spin rate + projector-ray glow + plate float

scale.doc: view size and quadrant spread — a true plate zoom

density.doc: number of mounting bores through the base (2..4)

speed.doc: rate of the part morph and the pictorial rotation

hue.doc: plate tint (film/ghost styles); other styles are fixed inks

morph.doc: how fast the part's features drift — the dimensions are live

anno.doc: annotation density: dimensions, projectors, view labels, projection symbol, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: toned drafting film / prussian cyanotype / aged engraved plate / additive x-ray ghost (all internal structure shown at once) / wire (pure CAD wireframe, every edge, no fills)

seed.doc: part proportions, feature phasing, and first- vs third-angle convention

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
